description: List the apps you connected to Last Price by signing in (Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients), newest first: each one's id, name, the host it returns to, the workspace, whether it has full access or which scopes, and when it was connected and last used. this_app marks the connection making this call. Read-only. Needs a credential that names a person: signing in to Last Price from this MCP client, or a person token. An API key names a workspace, not a person, and gets 403. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_connected_apps
